name: dsh-plugin-upgrade
description: Upgrade skill for DSH plugin authors: one package carrying one corridor index that reads the caller declared DSH range and routes it to the matching closed corridor card, plus a zero-dependency seam scanner.
longDescription: 面向 DSH 插件作者的升级技能：一个包内一份走廊索引，按调用方声明的 DSH 区间路由到对应已封版升级卡片，附零依赖接缝扫描器。
